diagnostic_thresholds.note: descriptive sample thresholds, not an SLO or confidence bound

legacy_column_semantics.tpot_p95_ms: p95 over finite ITLs pooled across requests; finite gap count was not retained

decode_context_retrospective.inference_unit: 27 correlated staircase cells from three physical bundles
decode_context_retrospective.limitation: both features use achieved throughput; profile normalization also includes heldout context maxima

request_simulation_ab.boundary: whole requests are FCFS-serialized; active decode cannot exceed one

powertrace_empirical_reference.evidence_role: external disaggregated-serving empirical sensitivity; not a Queue-Haul treatment effect or admission model

slo.denominator: all offered requests; uncompleted requests are misses

analysis_protocol.dynamic_gain: max(0, x dot y / x dot x) above fixed role idle
analysis_protocol.equal_parameter_null: source-scheduler role busy fraction plus the same fixed idle and one fitted nonnegative gain
analysis_protocol.fit_loss: pointwise squared error in watts per role
analysis_protocol.sample_mapping: evaluate the 250 ms source-ledger bin containing each query midpoint; retain every sample and never average duplicate bins
analysis_protocol.temporal_alignment: no fitted lag, interpolation, or warping
analysis_protocol.uncertainty_unit: cell; report every held-out cell and paired replay range

powertrace_empirical_reference.uncertainty_boundary: Report recorded-cell ranges. Cells share campaign stacks and there are only two or three per rate; request bootstrap measures within-trace sampling only and cannot create independent runs or a missing Queue-Haul counterfactual.
